preconditions.description: The number of gifts is between 1 and 200,000.
The pleasantness of each gift is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.
The gift IDs in the description of the ropes are valid and within the range of gift IDs.
The gift IDs in the description of the ropes are distinct.

preconditions.expression: All the gifts hang on the first gift
preconditions.description: The tree structure is such that all gifts are connected to the first gift.

postconditions.expression: output is either an integer or the string 'Impossible'
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible sum of pleasantness or 'Impossible' if it is not possible to choose gifts without fighting.
